note: Files: runs/theory-rows/abaybektursun-1114-153825-208b/answers.jsonl (base, cue) and runs/theory-rows/abaybektursun-1114-183640-e828/answers.jsonl (RL, plain); fetched with modal volume get into runs/theory-tests/<job>/ if the theory-rows copy is missing. Selection: attempt == 0, sample in 0-3, first row per (problem_index, sample) in file order taken BEFORE the finished filter (a first row that is a cap hit drops that slot, it is not replaced by a later row), then drop cap_hit true or finish_reason 'length'. SW regex and S = len(re.findall) on the full text field, T = n_new, from the first recipe of draft r8-m02. Statistic = sum S / sum T (base) over the same for RL; +inf if RL S = 0 and base S > 0; refuted_without_number if both are 0, as the recipe says (despite refuted_by being null). Interval: bootstrap over problem_index, each entry the pair (base kept rows, RL kept rows) of that problem; n = smaller of the two counts of problems with kept rows. alt_measured: same ratio with T = n_generated instead of n_new (base rows carry a 3-token cue prefix, so the token denominators may differ). Caveat: the base text field may start inside the cue prefix (' line!'), so S counts any marker in the text field as stored.
